name: Juni
source:
A girl whose life revolves around a virtual reality fighting game named Trankill (TK). She is one of those few people who literally live and work in the game, not just play it. Along with her fellow refugees from the now destroyed island of Silen, she is shunned by the society she lives in and forced into solitude. For far too long she has ignored her past and been content with surviving day to day.

[From [url=https://summerfoundme.wordpress.com/tranquil-tempest/]official homepage[/url].]
